title: Vesper and the Spire
author: Isandro Marchetti
blurb: August Coldharbour, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
